description:
Replace literal well-known `.jit` file names in commands with `VirtualPath` constants.

## Background

`VirtualPath` declares well-known data-root files through `declare_well_known_paths!` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/path.rs:259-310`), and host paths derive through `RepositoryLayout::resolve` (`path.rs:530`). Commands spell them as literals in `commands/validate.rs` (7 lines), `commands/init.rs` (7), and `commands/gate.rs`, `commands/mod.rs`, `commands/config.rs`, `commands/profile.rs`, `commands/claim.rs`, `commands/snapshot.rs` and `commands/project.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No string literal under `crates/jit/src/commands/`, server control files excepted, builds or matches the path of a well-known `.jit` file; message text that names a file for a reader is not a path site.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each such site uses a `VirtualPath` constant, and host paths derive through `RepositoryLayout::resolve`.
title: Commands name well-known files through VirtualPath constants
